metadata.article_title: Cognizance of offence committed by Protection Officer.

article.title: Cognizance of offence committed by Protection Officer.
article.content:
34Cognizance of offence committed by Protection Officer.

Section 34  ·  Chapter V  ·  page 11 of the Act
No prosecution or other legal proceeding shall lie against the Protection Officer unless a complaint is filed with the previous sanction of the State Government or an officer authorised by it in this behalf.
